Chapter 639: Chapter 48: Lin Yuan’s Threat Level (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

Human civilization is such, the Insect Race is such, the Tianyu Clan is also such.

The gentle Mother of the Tree Realm looked at the young ancient tree, a unique life form in the universe, which had no concept of kin after growing to the Eleventh Rank.

Until the birth of this young ancient tree.

The young ancient tree was not nurtured by the Mother of the Tree Realm but birthed from the Tree Realm itself, just like the situation when the Mother of the Tree Realm was born.

“Mother,” the young ancient tree likewise emitted psychic waves, with a hint of confusion, “you said our Tree Realm’s species has talents and qualifications that truly surpass all beings in the universe?”

“That is naturally so,” the vast Mother of the Tree Realm said with a smile, “the universe is vast, fostering endless lives, but our Tree Realm’s species, unique and singular, naturally surpasses all other beings in talent and qualifications.”

...

“What about the Supreme Beings?” the young ancient tree immediately asked.

The Supreme Beings did not wish to force the Mother of the Tree Realm because she possessed the ability not to give any advantage to the Supreme Beings, but in terms of strength and other aspects, the Mother of the Tree Realm was still far inferior to the Supreme Beings.

“Supreme Beings…” The Mother of the Tree Realm suddenly fell silent.

There are many Supreme Beings in the universe, who have not experienced as many years as it.

“Supreme Beings are an exception,” the Mother of the Tree Realm thought, “becoming a Supreme Being has little to do with talents and qualifications.”

“However, below the Supreme Beings, our Tree Realm’s species definitely looks down upon everything. Perhaps some other special life forms in the universe have talents and qualifications not weaker than our race, at most slightly stronger, but overall, they are on the same level.”

The Mother of the Tree Realm said confidently.

“But mother, not long ago, an envoy from the Insect Race asked me to create an avatar to go to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to confront the Galactic Star Lord of human civilization…”

The young ancient tree immediately began to speak.

“Hmm…” The Mother of the Tree Realm nodded, knowing nothing of the Galactic Star Lord, whose rise was too rapid, less than a hundred years.

Most of the time, the Mother of the Tree Realm maintained a substantial difference in the flow of time from the outside world to extend her lifespan.

The lifespan of the Tree Realm species is frighteningly long, but without becoming a Supreme Being, they are ultimately just lives in the River of Time, unable to achieve eternity.

The last time she woke up was a million years ago.

“The result is that my avatar died at the hands of the Galactic Star Lord, and the opponent did not use any external force,” the young ancient tree said with a hint of confusion.

Even after watching the video of the Galactic Star Lord in action, when it actually faced the Galactic Star Lord, it began to doubt.

Are you really the special life form or is it the Galactic Star Lord?

“Died at the hands of the Galactic Star Lord?”

The Mother of the Tree Realm fell silent, “The opponent did not use any external force?”

Here, “external force” refers to higher-level Secret Treasures or life-saving items.

Like the “Time Black Hole” of Maduo Traveler.

“Galactic Star Lord.” The Mother of the Tree Realm immediately extended her consciousness beyond the Tree Realm, beginning to receive all the events that occurred during her dormant period, including the numerous reports about the Galactic Star Lord.

Broke the Eighth-Layer myth.

The youngest Ninth Rank in the history of human civilization…

“Child…”

After a long time, the Mother of the Tree Realm finally emitted psychic waves again, “Don’t worry about the Galactic Star Lord.”

“What use is a high talent and qualification for the Galactic Star Lord? As long as he doesn’t become a Supreme Being, he definitely won’t outlive you.”

The Mother of the Tree Realm thought for a while and finally came up with a comforting reason.

The lifespan of the Tree Realm species, unbelievably long, even for the Ninth Rank young ancient tree, spans beyond what normal Eleventh-Rank Life could experience by hundreds, even thousands of times.

“The Galactic Star Lord won’t outlive me…” The ancient tree felt somewhat unsettled upon hearing this.

…

The Tianyu Clan.

Many Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank Godlords watched the “video footage” in front of them.

It was Lin Yuan in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, slaying “Children of the Tree Realm,” “Dragon Scale King,” and other legendary Ninth Rank scenes.

“In this battle, the spatial layers created by the Galactic Star Lord indeed amounted to around two hundred million, consistent with the strength displayed when killing Hunyi,” one of them said.

“Additionally, the Galactic Star Lord also mastered an Eruption-type Secret Skill that can, for a short time, unleash more than double his own strength.”

“Such Eruption-type Secret Skills should have significant drawbacks; otherwise, with the strength of the Galactic Star Lord, he should have continued to pursue. But he didn’t, instead watching helplessly as our clan’s warriors escaped into the inner area.”

…

A series of Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank Godlords of the Tianyu Clan, based on the “video footage,” attempted to deduce detailed information about the Galactic Star Lord.

They paid a significant price to invite a legendary Ninth Rank to enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, all to test the ultimate limits of the Galactic Star Lord.

For better targeting the Galactic Star Lord in future large-scale battlefields.

In the eyes of the many Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank Godlords of the Tianyu Clan, the Galactic Star Lord will inevitably shine on the large battlefield in the future.

Not understanding the true limits of the Galactic Star Lord’s strength now would only lead to greater losses in the future.

“Based on the current strength of the Galactic Star Lord, if he steps into the Tenth Rank, achieving a transformational leap, his threat level in a millennium will reach ‘Grade B’. Extending the timeline, there is a high probability he will reach ‘Grade A’ within five thousand years,” one of the Eleventh Rank Godlords said.

Whether it’s the Evolvers of human civilization or the mightiest among other races, upon reaching the Tenth Rank level of life, the strength disparity does not have a specific standard.

Like Ninth Rank levels, which are differentiated according to the number of Spatial Layers initiated.
